title: How Do I Advertise on CTV | Comcast Advertising

facts.fact: CTV represents more than a third of total TV viewing, according to a Nielsen source cited by Comcast Advertising.
facts.quote: In fact, CTV represents more than a third of total TV viewing,1 so there’s no better time to learn how to advertise on CTV.

facts.fact: CTV ads typically look like traditional TV commercials, most commonly 15- or 30-second video spots.
facts.quote: CTV ads typically look like traditional TV commercials, most commonly 15- or 30-second video spots, but they are served in streaming environments with fewer ad breaks.

facts.fact: CTV advertisers typically pay based on impressions delivered to their desired audience.
facts.quote: CTV advertisers typically pay based on impressions delivered to their desired audience.

facts.fact: Connected TV advertising costs vary based on targeting, market size, ad length, and demand.
facts.quote: Connected TV advertising costs vary based on targeting, market size, ad length, and demand, but CTV advertisers typically pay based on impressions delivered to their desired audience.

facts.fact: CTV campaigns can be evaluated using digital-style outcomes such as website visits, app downloads, and conversions, in addition to impressions and reach.
facts.quote: In addition to impressions and reach, CTV campaigns can be evaluated using digital-style outcomes such as website visits, app downloads, and conversions.

facts.fact: Self-serve DIY CTV platforms may be more budget friendly than a fully managed agency approach, according to Comcast Advertising.
facts.quote: The DIY method can use a variety of self-serve platforms that may be more budget friendly.
